verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships its own testing doubles, TestModel and FunctionModel, so agents can be exercised in tests without calling real model providers. A community user corroborates the ability to mock the LLM client for testing. However, this is model mocking (closer to a dry-run) rather than an isolated sandbox environment, and nothing documents isolating tools or data from production. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment that isolates tool and data access from production, guidance on keeping production data untouched during tests, and hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Pydantic AI also comes with TestModel and FunctionModel for testing and development.
